title: fix: factor shared custom properties in adjacent rules
author: SyMind
summary: Draft PR adding a new cross-rule optimization in CssRuleList::minify: extracts custom properties shared by adjacent rules into a combined-selector rule when it shrinks raw output, plus selector-compat and nesting-detection changes. Big, risky minifier transform with a cost/benefit trade-off (raw -12% on one theme file, brotli +67 B) that the maintainer should approve in principle before anyone does a full review.
evidence: Still a draft. kdy1 (member) 2026-10-29 found a `revert-rule !important` counterexample reproduced in Chromium 156; author pushed 0a1bc67 'preserve rule boundaries for revert-rule' on 2026-11-03 (not re-verified here). Also touches selector compatibility for :host()/::slotted()/::cue() arguments and nesting detection inside :has(). Author notes output is not idempotent across passes. Calibration: maintainer weighs precision against complexity and perf on rule lists.
decision: Do we want a 1.3k-line custom-property factoring pass in the rule minifier (raw size gains, compressed size neutral or worse), or is it out of scope given the complexity and risk?
